title: An answer file — a change's answers to friction
description: A backbone file schema (ADR-056) for an answer file: a file in the answer folder, `.pkit/project/friction/answers/`, which the backbone fixes (COR-062 points 1 and 2; ADR-068 point 1). Bound by its location, never by a field. One mapping with an `answers` list; each entry holds one artefact's answers — a revalidation, deferrals and revisit entries, with the keys COR-050 names — and `read`, the other answer files on that artefact its answers read (COR-062 point 4), named by their names in the folder. An entry may hold deferrals alone, as a block may. Whether a name in `read` is honoured, whether an answer is live, and whether an entry names an artefact at all are the backbone's to judge from history, not this schema's. Backbone-owned; carries no version of its own and is migrated when it changes (COR-010), preserving the parsed value of `at` (ADR-056 point 3).

answers.description: One entry per artefact the file answers on. A second entry for one artefact in one file is a validation error, as is an empty list: such a file answers nothing.

artefact.description: The artefact's location when the answer was added: a document's path, or a collection entry's file path, `#` and its id. The checks follow it through the renames of the artefact's file since (COR-062 point 10).

read.description: The other answer files that held an answer on this artefact in the tree of the change's own head, by their names in the folder (COR-062 point 4; ADR-068 point 2). Holds for every answer in the entry.

revisited.description: One entry per target of a link whose source's change revisits it (COR-050 point 16). A second entry for one target within one answer is a validation error.

revalidated.title: A revalidation, its deferrals, or both (COR-050 points 3 and 4)
revalidated.description: `at` is the marker of a revalidation and comes with its `outcome`; `unchanged` requires `unchanged-because`. An entry that only defers carries `deferred` alone; an empty mapping is refused.

unchanged-because.description: Why the content still holds against this change; required with `outcome: unchanged`.

deferred.description: One entry per anchor whose friction is deliberately postponed. A second entry for one anchor within one answer is a validation error.

anchor-reference.title: An anchor written as its kind and value

answer-file-name.description: An answer file's name in the folder: a YAML file directly in it, never a path.
